✅ VN-ROM Control
Fixing a frozen Seekbar.
Add phone information display.
Brand-New Dashboard: Completely redesigned UI for VN-ROM Control.
Enhanced Navigation: Sidebar removed, replaced with a modern bottom Dock for quick access.
App Management: New App Disabler (Freeze/Hide) feature integrated.
Smart Search: Instantly find settings and applications within the app.
Icon Customization: Colorize icons and backgrounds (Custom, Dynamic, or Random colors).
Advanced Styling: Customize text colors and background effects (Blur, Matrix, or Custom images).
✅ VN-ROM Features
Camera Energy Ring: Customizable animated glowing ring around the front camera.
Battery Master: Customize default battery icons, colors (Light/Dark mode), and fonts.
Real-time Weather: Live weather display directly on the Status Bar.
Connectivity Icons: New options for WiFi 5/7G and 5G+ Signal Spoofing.
Lockscreen Polish: Custom colors for icons on the lockscreen.
Quick Panel Art: Support for custom background images and solid colors.
Custom Backgrounds: Support for Matrix effects and custom images in Quick Settings and Notification panels.
Device Information: Display detailed hardware and software info directly in the dashboard.
Quick Launch Bar: Added a customizable shortcut bar for instant app access.
Refined Notifications: Redesigned rounded notification backgrounds to match stock aesthetics.
Instant Apply: Notification color changes now take effect immediately.
RAM Monitor: Modernized rounded design for the RAM viewer in Navigation Bar.
Power Menu Pro: Advanced power options now fully integrated.
Seamless Engine: 97% of mods apply instantly without SystemUI restart (Except Signal/WiFi icons).
Many more improvements! Explore for yourself in this stable OneUI 8.x release.
✅ Settings
Exclusive VN-ROM Dashboard: A redesigned, user-friendly settings interface.
Real-time System Monitor: Live tracking of RAM, Storage, and Battery temperature.
One-Tap Optimizer: Instantly clear RAM and clean system junk for peak performance.
Device Identity: Dynamic header displaying your Galaxy model and ROM version.
Storage Engine: Accurate capacity detection for 128GB/256GB/512GB/1TB models.
Battery Health: Improved thermal monitoring and charging status accuracy.
Integrated Advanced Power Menu: Quick access to essential power options directly from the dashboard.
Pro Reboot Options: Soft Reboot, Recovery Mode, and Download Mode (Odin) with a single tap.
Integrated ROM Changelog: Stay informed with the latest updates! You can now view detailed version history, new features, and bug fixes directly within the VN-ROM Settings interface.
